summary.intent: Adversarially review Callisto change #242 (git diff origin/main...HEAD) against a review contract, owner decisions, and AGENTS.md, confirming defects only via throwaway failing tests, then cleaning up and leaving git status unchanged.
summary.outcome: Three failures were confirmed with failing tests: required JSON init review write failure downgraded to a warning, capture_stream treating Interrupted reads as EOF (pre-existing), and --help/--version bypassing the stdout sink on non-BrokenPipe errors. Other checks passed, and all throwaway tests and artifacts were removed with git status clean.

repo: Process-count tests (git_process_count_tests) with historical tags, legacy-listing positive control, and moved/dual manifest cases all passed (10 tests); closed_stream, init_recovery, init_origin, aggregate, shallow-clone, runner and workflow-matrix tests also passed.

Release e2e test harness (release_harness.rs) builds ~8 repos and can make live git ls-remote lookups with 60s timeouts, making release_command_e2e_tests very slow and creating callisto-test-registry-* temp dirs that need cleanup.
Explicit `callisto help` routes through the shared stdout sink and returns E213 on non-BrokenPipe errors, but clap's Cli::parse path for --help/--version does not.
Entire Brain brief fails in this sandbox because its lock file is outside the writable area; direct source inspection is needed.

code.finding: Automatic workflow preparation catches errors from a function that also writes required review narration, so a required write failure (JSON init, GitHub origin) becomes an optional-workflow warning and init succeeds with config written instead of E213.

capture_stream's read loop treats all read errors, including ErrorKind::Interrupted, as EOF, truncating captured output silently; should retry Interrupted and surface other errors as capture failures.
Cli::parse lets clap print help/version and drop the write result, so --help, status --help and --version exit 0 on WouldBlock stdout; should use try_parse and render via the shared stdout sink.

friction: Entire Brain brief failed due to a lock file outside the writable sandbox.
The release e2e suite was very slow due to repeated live git lookups with 60s timeouts in fixture setup.
The release harness left temp registry directories outside the repo that had to be found and removed manually.
Ranger audit skill artifacts (workspace manifest, candidates, findings JSON) added overhead on top of the requested review report.
open_items: Fix init so required review narration write errors propagate as E213 before the optional workflow-preparation fallback.
Fix capture_stream to retry Interrupted and propagate other read errors as capture failures (pre-existing but contrary to the capture contract).
Switch main.rs to try_parse and route help/version output through the shared stdout sink, preserving usage exit 2 and closed-pipe success.
